name: SIM Swap / Unauthorized eSIM Hijack
description: Victim's phone showed 'No Service' abruptly, followed by unauthorized Netbanking transfers while cellular signal was hijacked.

intakePayload.description: Phone suddenly lost cellular connectivity at 3 PM. Upon connecting to office Wi-Fi, saw emails alerting that Netbanking password was reset and Rs. 75,000 transferred via IMPS.

victim.name: Vikram Malhotra
